description: From the end of the road this 4 km trail climbs steeply up the west side of the ridge, through heavy timber, into the sub alpine and then continues south along the ridge to a rustic cabin. The trail is primarily a winter snowmobile route, as a result hikers will encounter wet areas and steep sections. There are excellent views of the surrounding mountain ranges from the trail. The cabin is managed and maintained by the Kitimat Snowmobile Club under an agreement with the Recreation Sites and Trails Branch. The cabin has a registration book. Please use it.
directions: From the Kitimat Chamber of Commerce office, located on Highway 37, head east along Forestry Avenue and the South Hirsch forestry road for approximately 7.5 km. At this point (Branch 100) turn right and the road begins to climb towards the south. After another 4 km the trailhead is reached. Sections of the road are rough and require 4WD.
